title: One cut, no words
line: A family kimchi workshop: a huge cabbage is thrown, split, and opens on a yellow heart
proof: Sold: more than 40-fold in two months, the family says

title: Open what is closed
line: A Brooklyn bakery: a spoon goes into a golden crust and a white core melts out
proof: Seen 7 million times, 346.5 times its usual

title: The empty stall
line: A stranger buys only where nobody stands; a small jerky maker offers a sample
proof: Sold: more than 2,200 orders, the owner says

title: Your kitchen is a stage
line: A candy shop: glowing syrup as big as a man, children staring through the glass
proof: Seen 47 million times, 717.6 times its usual

title: Prove it in one gesture
line: A customer puts a spoon into the milk, and the thick cream keeps the hole
proof: Sold: half-gallon orders doubled, the owner says
